description: Issues are disabled on this repository, so Renovate has nowhere to open its Dependency Dashboard. Turn dependencyDashboard back on if issues are ever enabled.

packageRules.description: Astro requires react and react-dom to be the exact same version, so they must be bumped together in a single PR

config:best-practices pulls in security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm, which sets npm to 3 days via a packageRule. packageRules beat top-level config, so the 7 day cooldown carried over from .github/dependabot.yml has to be re-asserted here or npm silently runs at 3 days. Same rule as the monorepo.

This is our own release, so the 7 day cooldown above only delays us bumping our own tags. Same 0 day treatment mergify-ci-buildkite-plugin's own renovate.json gives Mergifyio/mergify-cli, just without a hold at all since nothing external needs to catch up first.
Our own release too, so no cooldown, same as the buildkite plugin rule above.

customManagers.description: buildkite-plugin-version-sync.yml (ci-bot) copies the latest mergify-ci-buildkite-plugin release tag into this file today; let Renovate bump it directly instead.

The gha-mergify-ci version the docs examples pin. github-releases rather than github-tags: a tag can exist days before its release is published, and the pin should only move once it is. /integrations/gha/reference does not read this file; it renders the vendored src/data/gha-mergify-ci-action.yml under its own stamped tag.
